ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of white-to-black pixels; the visible ventral surface is dominated by a large white central expanse with significant black pigmentation localized at the peduncle and the right lobe trailing edge.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe is characterized by a continuous white region extending to a black distal tip. Right lobe contains a large white interior polygon truncated by a broad, irregular black margin along the trailing edge. A deep black pigmentation field originates at the peduncle and flares into the medial section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation with a calculated interior angle of approximately 50 degrees and a deep vertical bounding box relative to the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Right lobe trailing edge exhibits high-frequency, high-amplitude macro-serrations (jagged peaks and deep valleys). Left lobe trailing edge is predominantly linear with a single major disruption caused by a barnacle cluster at the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a straight-line linear sweep towards the distal tip. Right lobe trailing boundary follows an irregular, jagged convex trajectory.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-intensity white pixel clusters corresponding to barnacle colonies (Coronula diadema) are localized at the distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular tissue erosion and deep serrations along the trailing edge of the right fluke lobe, creating a distinctive 'saw-tooth' profile.
other_distinctive_markers: A prominent black pigmentation 'bridge' connects the central peduncle area to the lower-medial section of the right fluke lobe.
